question: Why do people fail to embrace the liberating dharma of Kula?
premises: People do not resort to Kula.
Kula-dharma releases one from the bond of worldly becoming.
The liberating quality of Kula-dharma is not embraced.
inference: People do not take up the dharma of Kula that frees from the bondage of existence.
plain_english: They do not resort to the Kula dharma, which liberates from the bondage of worldly existence.
